title: Twins and Cats
voice: Unsigned gallery voice; curation/voice/style-guide.md as amended 2026-10-16 (Feeling and message)
dateBasis: UTC. recordedAt is the token's mint instant where the chain records it (Tezos; tokens the collector minted); otherwise null. collectedAt is the first transfer into the collector's wallet.
method: New room written October 16, 2026 for the After Nifty Ink wing. Every work was inspected from its fetched original (first frame for animations) on one contact sheet and at up to 1000 px. Identities, dates, prices and wallets come from data/onchain.json (the Mac's October 16 recovery of the EVM holdings; objkt and TzKT for Tezos); the artist's posts from curation/research/social/x-posts.json; the artist's token and collection descriptions from the chain metadata. No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 20 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: What the artist sent to the people who held the inks. In the spring and summer of 2022 nnxyz used a second chain, Polygon, where minting cost almost nothing, to make things for collectors on the drawing board: a pixelated twin for every Nifty Face a person held, a club of flat cartoon cats, a few one-off pieces dropped into the wallets of the buyers who had kept coming back. Twenty works, April to October 2022, and every one of them arrived unasked for.

On April 21, 2022, the artist promised that once the Faces reached 130, every holder would receive the matching pixelated version, number one the same as the original and all the others changed a little so each was unique. On May 4 the artist posted that everyone should now have theirs. Six of the Faces in the second wing have their twins here, and the twin of the Faces origin piece arrived in October, seven weeks after the collector bought the original. The cats came in July, when the artist wrote that every holder of an ink should by now have a chic city cat, and then sold the rest for one MATIC each; the collector bought ten in one evening.

These are the artist's thank-you notes, and they are drawn in a different hand from the inks: flat vector shapes, pixel grids, no scribble. Look at the twins beside the Faces they copy, if you know them. The same grin, with the line taken out and the grid put in, is still a grin.

chapters.title: Two Drops in April
chapters.opening: April 28, 2022. Two pieces the artist dropped into the collector's wallet on one day: the only survivor of an eight-piece Polygon set, and a pixel figure from a series called pxlpop.

works.title: nnxyz #5
works.text: A tall dark figure in magenta and red scribble on black, drawn in a vertical frame twice as high as it is wide: a head, a long body, thin lines running down like rain. It is the one survivor of a Polygon contract the artist called simply nnxyz, eight pieces minted, seven of them burned by the artist afterwards. The collector received it on April 28, 2022, three days after the artist first minted a milestone drawing into his wallet on the drawing board. A figure in the dark, drawn tall for a phone, is the first thing nnxyz made for him off the board, and it is the loneliest picture in the wing.
works.caption: A tall dark figure in magenta and red scribble on black, in a frame twice as high as wide.
works.reading: The figure fills the lower two thirds of a vertical frame, its head a round mass of magenta line, its body streaked with thin pink and red strokes that run down toward the bottom edge. The ground is black with faint colored marks.

facts.createdAtBasis: unknown: the token was minted by the artist before the transfer

works.title: nnxyz pxlpop #2.01
works.text: A pixel figure with blond hair in a blue jacket and dark trousers stands against a brown gradient scattered with stars, drawn on a coarse grid like a character from a 1990s game. The artist posted on May 8, 2022, that a pxlpop had gone as a second little airdrop to a collector who kept filling his pockets with the inks; this one went to Jamie Thingelstad ten days earlier, on April 28. It is the artist's pixel style before the Faces got theirs, and the figure is standing at ease with its hands at its sides, the only relaxed body in the room.
works.caption: A pixel figure with blond hair in a blue jacket stands on a brown gradient scattered with stars.
works.reading: The figure is drawn in large square pixels, its face pale with a few dark pixels for features, its jacket blue with lighter highlights, its trousers dark. The ground is a brown-to-tan gradient with white pixel stars.

facts.createdAtBasis: unknown: the token was minted by the artist before the transfer

chapters.title: Pixel Twins
chapters.opening: May 1 to 4, 2022. Six Faces the collector held were sent their pixelated twins within days of the artist's promise. Each is the drawing redrawn on a grid, the colors kept and the line replaced by squares.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces px #105
works.text: A mosaic of a mask: boxed eyes, a grille of white teeth, a yellow crown of spikes, the whole square filled with colored tiles on green. It is Nifty Faces #105 turned into pixels, drawn, in the artist's words, so that every Face a person held got its matching twin. The collector received it on May 1, 2022, the day after the artist had finished sending them. Look at the original in the Faces wing and then at this: the scribble that made the face is gone, and the tiles do the same work with no line at all. The grin survives the translation, which says something about how little it ever depended on the line.
works.caption: A mosaic of a mask on green: boxed eyes, white teeth, a yellow crown of spikes, in colored tiles.
works.reading: The mask fills the square in blocks of green, yellow, red, blue and white. Two boxed eyes sit high, a long grille of white tiles runs across the lower face, and yellow spikes stand along the top edge.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces px #160
works.text: An angry mask on dark red: two red eyes under heavy brows, a crown of orange spikes, a grille of white teeth, all in tiles. The original, Faces #160, hangs in the room of skulls in the dark. On the grid the anger reads at a glance: the brows are two dark diagonals, the eyes two red squares, and nothing softens them. chapters.title: The Cat Club
chapters.opening: July 15 to October 15, 2022. Eleven chic city cats: three sent free to the collector as a holder of the inks, seven bought for one MATIC each on August 21, and one that arrived on the day New Nifty on the Block ended.

works.title: nnxyzcccc #6
works.text: A blue cat sits in profile on a grey ledge, its body striped in pale blue, its tail curled pink, against a ground split on the diagonal between teal and a darker blue. The eyes are two X marks. It is one of the first chic city cats, number 6 of nearly ten thousand, and it came to the collector on July 15, 2022, the day the artist posted that everyone who held an ink should by now have received a cat. The club was the artist's answer to a promise made in May, when the cats of the spring were still black silhouettes on the board; here the cat is flat, blue and sitting still, and the X eyes are the only thing it kept from the drawings.

works.title: nnxyzcccc #275
works.text: A cyan cat with a halo sits on a split ground of purple and green, its eyes two small marks, its tail white. It came to the collector on October 15, 2022, the Saturday the artist drew the last three works of New Nifty on the Block, and the day before the whole of that series was sent to him. chapters.title: The Last Twin
chapters.opening: October 4, 2022. The pixel twin of the Faces origin piece, sent seven weeks after the collector bought the original.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces px #0000
works.text: The Faces origin piece in tiles: a dark square packed with blocks of red, blue, yellow and white, the artist's name spelled across it in pixels where the original spelled it in scribble, a grille of white teeth low in the frame. The collector bought Nifty Faces #0000 on August 13, 2022, for five hundred xDai, and on October 4 the artist sent him its twin, the only pixel twin that was not part of the May airdrop. The twins were made for everyone who held a Face. This one was made for the one person who held the Face that held all the others, and it closes the room the way the original closes its wing: a name, a grin, and the whole series packed in behind them.
works.caption: The Faces origin piece in tiles: a dark square packed with colored blocks, the artist's name in pixels.
works.reading: The square is tiled edge to edge in reds, blues, yellows, greens and white on a dark ground. Blocky letters cross the middle, and a grille of white tiles sits low in the frame. No line is visible; everything is squares.
